text.p: The Turkish lira weakened to 86,210 to the dollar from Tuesday's close of 86,160 because of a cash surplus and the dollar's earlier rise against the mark.
Overnight money rates continued to ease and the central bank drained excess cash through overnight dealings and overnight repos at midday.
The central bank drained 2.2 trillion lira of excess money overnight at 50 percent at the close after rates fluctuated between 50.75 and 68 percent during the day.

In addition to the 36.16 trillion lira of March 5, 1997 paper the treasury auctioned on Tuesday, banks bought another nine trillion lira through optional sales at an average yield of 135 percent on Wednesday.
Banks paid a total of 28.5 trillion lira to the treasury. A total of 51.5 trillion lira were cashed in from maturing t-bills, reducing money rates and lowering t-bill yields by one to three points.
The yield on the most active March 5 paper, sold at yesterday's auction, fell by 2.5 points to 132.46 percent.
That one the second most active December 4 paper traded at 115.53 percent, down from 118.10 at Tuesday's close. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
